subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer the single enabled/configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit/default account selection when the default account is disabled?
rationale: The requested fallback changes documented default-account behavior for existing multi-account setups, so the linked PR needs maintainer policy acceptance before landing.

options.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
options.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep Explicit Account Selection
options.body: Keep current default-account semantics and document that users must set `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require Channel-Owned Fallback
options.body: Ask for a channel-owned adjustment if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept Shared Resolver Policy
recommendation.body: Review and land a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account, with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the prior resolver direction for this issue and has recent history near the channel-routing/account-helper policy.
